title: Lumbar Laminectomy and Decompression for Spinal Stenosis
description: Medicare coverage guidelines for lumbar laminectomy/decompression without fusion. Requires neurogenic claudication or radicular pain matching moderate to severe central or lateral recess stenosis on MRI/CT, and failure of at least 6 weeks of conservative therapy.

criteria.name: Severe Central or Foraminal Stenosis on MRI/CT
criteria.description: Diagnostic MRI or CT confirming moderate to severe lumbar central canal, subarticular, or neural foraminal stenosis correlating with clinical symptoms.
entity_names: moderate to severe stenosis on mri
keywords: moderate to severe stenosis on mri
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Endoscopically assisted laminotomy/laminectomy, which requires open and direct visualization, as well as other open lumbar decompression procedures for LSS are not within the scope of this NCD and coverage is at contractor discretion.

criteria.name: Conservative Therapy Trial Failure (>= 6 Weeks)
criteria.description: Trial and failure of >= 6 weeks of non-surgical conservative therapy class (physical therapy, activity modification, NSAIDs/analgesics, chiropractic care, home exercise). Note: Instance list is author-defined from policy non-operative care section; source status is MISMATCH/unverified.
criteria.clinical_intent: Mandatory trial of non-operative conservative therapy class
criteria.source_text_excerpt: Does PILD provide a clinically meaningful improvement of function (e.g., reduced acute and post-acute hospitalizations, nursing home care or inpatient rehabilitation services) and/or quality of life in Medicare beneficiaries with LSS compared to other treatments?

criteria.name: Absence of Neurologic Symptoms Exclusion
criteria.description: Asymptomatic stenosis or incidental radiologic stenosis in the absence of functional claudication or radiculopathy.
criteria.source_text_excerpt: The eligibility requirements, both inclusion and exclusion criteria that were specified in the CMS-approved RCT protocol, must be maintained in the new prospective, longitudinal study.

cms_reference.notes: Verified from official CMS Coverage API /v1/data/ncd?ncdid=358. Replaces MISMATCH (previously cited L35081 was Nerve Conduction Studies).
